items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: Barbara had a hundred piece orchestra.

ctx.x: I mean what would Rancid want from you?

Barbara had a hundred piece orchestra. Rancid, they wanted me to play timbales. I don’t remember what else I played but I remember playing timbales with them. And they just wanted me to rock out, like you know, go man. Okay. Wow, that’s a good comparison.
Was it a live thing or did you have to do headphones?
